title: clidemia capitellata var. neglecta
intro: Clidemia capitellata var. neglecta, commonly known as the purple passion flower or purple passionflower vine, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide several health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Clidemia capitellata var. neglecta include its potential to treat fever, pain, and respiratory issues, as well as its use in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
